title: Started my own Backrooms project and i am really suprised how well modern LLMs work.
author: Simple-Law5883
selftext: I've started this project today (to be fair i have some idea of game dev) but i am still baffled at how far i got in such a short time. I actually dreaded the animation/modeling part and thought i'd have to do it by hand, but nope, gemini and Fable are absolute monsters. Fable modelled the hand and the camera while gemini build the backrooms level 0 procedural generation + textures which blew my mind. It built very good looking 4k textures and fable actually managed to build a pretty good hand model with guidance. This would've taken me atleast a week or longer to build as i am not good with textures. I think that i personally can't compete with this level anymore without A.I.

replies.author: Simple-Law5883
replies.body: It's not fully planned out yet, but you're basically part of an explorer group where you set out to document anomalies, find artifacts and other missions. Basically a life sim within the backrooms. (I am planning to add tons of levels, i've already finished building tons of level 0 lore like the red rooms and manilla and such, poolrooms is also mostly finished. It's crazy how insanely fast this is going

comments.body:
This sub Reddit seems to be full of jerks and anti AI People. Very encouraging. 

To clarify a few point:

I am a huge backrooms fan and always wanted to put my own twist on this. I am not planning to create a walking simulator. THIS WAS LITERALLY a tech demo, nothing more. 90% of you guys have 0 things to show for, just a few negative comments. 

This video was only supposed to show how well and fast it works. People claiming I am ripping off anything, how dumb can you be? I am not generating any art, everything is built via code, textures, models everything.
